Hand with four fingers and a thumb

Palm on R³ (it translates, does not rotate), four three-link fingers and a two-link thumb, every link a rod on S¹ in its finger's flexion plane. PD joint torques close the hand into a cupped pose while a constant force holds the palm against gravity. Prototype built with geomech; not part of geomech.systems.
